# Gympanzie

> Gympanzie is an online fat-loss coaching business based in Shela, Ahmedabad, Gujarat, India. Its flagship offer is the 12-Week Lean Body Program for busy professionals, especially people over 30, led by certified fitness trainer and nutrition coach Payas Bharadwaj. The approach uses Indian meal plans (no need to give up roti or rice), short workouts that can be done at home, and routines instead of motivation.

## Key facts
- Founder and head coach: Payas Bharadwaj (certified Fitness Trainer, Nutrition Coach, Strength and Conditioning Coach, Glute Specialist, Corrective Exercise Specialist)
- Audience: busy working professionals, especially over 30
- Program: 12-Week Lean Body Program, starting with a free training video
- Delivery: online, available across India
- Location: J-1004, Orchid Sky, Club O7 Road, Shela, Ahmedabad, Gujarat 380058, India
- Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/gympanzie_/
- YouTube: https://www.youtube.com/channel/UCFcWd3tdZn0f9OHB4rOOhwQ
- Client results are individual and vary from person to person.
